# Levi Henry Group

> Consulting, education, and technology company helping individuals build high-income skills and small businesses build the systems that produce revenue. Founded by Levi Henry, with 15+ years across business, sales, sales leadership, and channel partnerships, working with businesses across North America.

## What we do
- Consulting: sales development, marketing, paid acquisition, and revenue operations for individuals and small businesses.
- Education: practical training and resources that build high-income skills (remote SDR / tech sales, go-to-market).
- Technology services: websites, funnels, payment integration, CRM, and the infrastructure behind client acquisition.

## Core offers
- For Individuals: high-income sales skills, the free Remote SDR Career Blueprint ebook, and the Remote SDR Mastery Course (on preorder).
- For Businesses: marketing & paid acquisition (Meta, TikTok, Google Ads, UGC, tracking & attribution, ad-account audits), plus funnels, technology, and revenue infrastructure. Paid Sales & Revenue Consultation available.
- For Founders: go-to-market (GTM) consulting for taking a product to market — positioning, first customers, pricing. Free GTM Field Manual and a paid GTM Strategy Consultation.
